title: anathallis asperilinguis
intro: Anathallis asperilinguis, commonly known as the 'tongue-tongue orchid', is a species of orchid found in the tropical regions of Central and South America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health, thanks to its therapeutic actions such as expectorant and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Anathallis asperilinguis include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties. However, further research is required to fully understand the plant's effects and potential applications in traditional medicine.
